plugins.name: duckdb-gdrive
plugins.description: Skills for the gdrive DuckDB extension: Google Drive in SQL -- secrets and sign-in (gcloud ADC, service accounts, workload identity, OAuth), the gdrive:// filesystem (paths, id:, globs, browser addresses, COPY, DuckLake, native Sheets and Docs), and Drive's metadata as tables (files with owners and links, search, versions, change feeds, permissions).
